rule: E18: at the capture commit, metrics.py read a binary score whose values all lie in [0, 1] as a probability. The valid probability metrics (log_loss, brier, ece, the threshold metrics) of an epoch whose logits all lie in [0, 1] are expected to differ once logits are read as logits (E18 fixed); they are compared only where outside_unit_interval is true (D1 §17.3).

capture.spec: the orders fixture's netspec.json (make_fixture.py), run R0: no delta
capture.fit_call: fit(model, spec, data, callbacks) with every other argument at its default: no budget, no checkpoint, grad_sample_every 0
capture.control: a second fit without the logit probe wrote identical records
